# Wiehr. Official Website

> Wiehr is a pseudonymous Belarus-born electronic composer and multidisciplinary artist creating cinematic, ambient, and experimental music.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wiehr.cc/): Listener network and country-based subscriptions
- [Archive](https://wiehr.cc/archive): Chronological archive of all releases, organized by year
- [Globe](https://wiehr.cc/globe): Music releases on an interactive 3D globe
- [Atlas](https://wiehr.cc/atlas): Photography collections on interactive terrain maps
- [Storage](https://wiehr.cc/storage): Digital downloads — fonts, presets, tools, assets
- [Lab](https://wiehr.cc/lab): Works, projects, and collaborations
- [About](https://wiehr.cc/about): Bio, contact, rates, and downloadable CVs
- [Rates](https://wiehr.cc/rates): Downloadable rates PDF
- [Licensing](https://wiehr.cc/licensing): License verification and signed documents
- [Privacy](https://wiehr.cc/privacy): Privacy Policy
- [Terms](https://wiehr.cc/terms): Terms of Service

## About

Electronic composer and software engineer. Genres include ambient, cyberpunk, dance, drum & bass, and techno. Each release is numbered and documented with geographic location, color palette, and emotional context.
